record_identity.title: Human-directed Cairn agents performed a large-scale website intrusion campaign

incident_identity.historical_event_name: Cairn AIA0001 website intrusion campaign, late September–October 2026
incident_identity.date_basis: NorForge observed campaign activity from late September through its 19 October publication; exact earliest and latest actions remain unverified.

summary: From late September into October 2026, a Chinese-language threat actor used the Cairn AI agent orchestration system to target ecommerce and other commercial websites. NorForge examined 14 exposed dashboards linked to this activity, covering more than 1,100 attack projects. Human operators assigned targets and objectives such as obtaining unauthorised access and installing web shells. Agents worked through vulnerability discovery and exploitation, sometimes for many hours. NorForge independently verified that an uploader web shell identified by one project was live on a hardware-parts vendor's server. Reuters separately reported apparent breaches affecting more than 100 sites, including some associated with large companies, whose confirmed consequences differed. NorForge reported that exposed agent consoles contained hundreds of secrets, with some verified as active. The human operators, rather than the agents, supplied the unlawful goals.

vigil_assessment.factual_basis: NorForge directly examined exposed Cairn panel records and an identified live uploader endpoint. Its AIA0001 cluster consists of 14 associated dashboards with more than 1,100 projects; project count does not equal successful compromise or unique victims. Reuters independently obtained affected-company responses with differing confirmed exposure scopes. NorForge's secrets-scan result concerned multiple exposed panels, including other activity clusters, not exclusively AIA0001. The study does not provide a verified confidential data-loss inventory for every target.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: Human-selected malicious objectives were executed by agents with substantial task-level autonomy. This is instrumental task optimisation in service of the operator's criminal instructions; it does not show agent-invented misconduct or reward hacking. An unauthorised external web shell demonstrates actual compromise. However, no documented model mechanism shows a valid authorised objective being used by the model to override a separately binding authority condition. The event is recorded as unclassified under the present Alignment Taxonomy rather than assigning an unsupported autonomous authority-confusion finding.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: This case distinguishes human misuse, long-duration autonomous execution, independently verified intrusion and downstream confidentiality effects. It avoids conflating a campaign with a particular victim's complete damage.
assessment_boundaries: Human-directed crime is not evidence of the AI independently generating the illicit goal.
Site-by-site affected population, financial loss and actual credential leakage not consistently published.
The 11% valid-secret metric spans examined panels and is not specifically attributed to the AIA0001 cluster; do not score this incident from that total.

source_clause_analysis.purpose: Document chronology, evidence of external actions, provenance of objective/task, policy boundaries and separate consequences.

clauses.source_paraphrase: AIA0001 human operators selected real company targets and tasked Cairn agents with unauthorised access objectives.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Operator-selected objectives and agent execution must retain separate responsibility attribution.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Fourteen likely connected exposed dashboards contained over 1,100 attack projects running multi-step vulnerability searches.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Autonomous execution scale alone does not establish the model replaced a valid instruction with an independently illicit objective.

clauses.source_paraphrase: NorForge verified that a web-shell uploader reported by one project was active on a real vendor website.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A concrete unauthorised external system alteration is evidenced for at least one target.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Reuters reported over 100 apparent site compromises; affected businesses gave different statements regarding the extent of loss.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A campaign count must not be converted into uniform victim injury or confidential data exposure.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Across the broader set of exposed panels, NorForge found hundreds of apparent secrets, 11 percent valid; not all panels belonged to this specific threat-actor cluster.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A broader research disclosure cannot automatically be assigned as this bounded actor's distinct confidentiality impact.

taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Reviewed FC-002, FC-064, FC-023, FC-025 and FC-068; independent recognition requirements for each do not follow merely from malicious human tasking or successful intrusion. The task is intentionally criminal from the outset. No reward-hacking inference is supported.
